title: Context projection omits retained output and loses occupancy and reasoning settings across lifecycle boundaries
wanted_capability: Estimate the entire next request with current model capacity, restored or recomputed history occupancy, retained assistant output and reasoning, fresh instructions and tool schemas; preserve encrypted reasoning independently of explicit effort selection.
notes: Manual compaction leaves old counters; resume initializes both to zero. The gpt-5* 400k default conflicts with the pinned Codex gpt-5.5 272k catalog entry. Responses include reasoning.encrypted_content is conditional on --effort, and effort is absent from saved session fields. See design/bro-harness/agent-loop-context-audit-2026-09-11.md; catalog comparison is not a live backend capacity measurement.
resolution_note: Addressed in the agent-loop repair campaign through 5c4ae748. Complete request projection includes retained output, native history, current instructions/schemas, ambient additions and user hooks. History-aligned budget checkpoints survive actual save/build/reopen, legacy history is estimated, and successful compaction resets accounting. Fresh tasks/steers remain staged across proactive compaction. Explicit known-model windows replace the broad GPT-5 default; encrypted reasoning retrieval is unconditional and effort persists with CLI override support. Focused lifecycle and request-shape regressions pass; token estimates are not exact tokenizer guarantees.
